name: Get marketing footer content
description: Call this when you need the Brevo marketing website's footer content — the social media links and footer navigation menus rendered at the bottom of app and corporate pages — for a given language locale. This serves presentation chrome from Brevo's WordPress corporate backend, not account data: it returns nothing about the signed-in user, their contacts, campaigns, or statistics. For the in-app navigation menus use navigation.get_header_menu instead; for the account's own details use organization.get_details.
preconditions: The locale path segment must correspond to a language site published on the corporate WordPress backend (observed: "pt").

locale.description: Language/locale path segment selecting which corporate site's footer to return, taken from the URL path before /wp-json (observed value: "pt").

social_menu.description: Social media links shown in the footer.

title.description: Display label for the link, e.g. "Twitter".

post_title.description: WordPress post title of the menu item, usually equal to title.

post_name.description: WordPress slug of the menu item, e.g. "twitter".

description.description: Optional descriptive text for the item; empty when unused.

url.description: Destination URL of the social profile.

icon.description: Absolute URL of the item's icon asset hosted on the corporate backend.

superscript_label.description: Optional small badge label rendered beside the title; empty when unused.

enable_item_descriptions_row_layout.description: Layout flag: render items in a row with their descriptions.

enable_without_description_column_layout.description: Layout flag: render items in a column without descriptions.

number_of_items_to_display.description: Number of items the renderer should display, carried as a string.

hide_on_smaller_screens.description: Whether the renderer hides this item on small viewports.

menu_tab_name.description: Name of the footer menu tab this item belongs to, e.g. "default".
